title: Leveraging high-throughput proteomics and AI-based protein folding to accelerate VAV1 molecular glue discovery.
authors: Lin, Hanfeng; Yu, Xin; Zheng, Haiyang; Cheng, Ran; Zhang, Min; Qi, Xiaoli; Yang, Yen-Yu; Zhou, Shengmin; Qi, Rui; Le, Ly; Bortolato, Andrea; Yesylevskyy, Semen; Nafiiev, Alan; Che, Xing; Wang, Jin
one_liner_zh: 该研究结合蛋白质组学、AI结构预测与FEP计算，加速VAV1分子胶降解剂发现，核心涉及蛋白结构计算建模，但对象为小分子降解剂而非纯蛋白质结构研究。
abstract: This study reports a series of CRBN molecular glues that selectively induce proteasomal degradation of VAV1, a hematopoietic-specific signaling protein and key target in hematological malignancies and autoimmune diseases. Using unbiased global proteomics, we identify phenyl-glutarimide derivatives (e.g., NGT-201-12) as effective VAV1 degraders that engage its C-terminal SH3 domain (SH3-2). We elucidate a non-canonical RT-loop degron (RDxS motif, residues 796-799) in SH3-2, distinct from previously characterized G-loop degrons, supported by the physics- and AI-driven GluePlex workflow and site-directed mutagenesis. Applying Free Energy Perturbation (FEP) to predicted ternary structures yields cooperativity metrics that correlate with degradation potency, overcoming limitations of standard docking and enabling prospective ranking of analogs-even from weak initial binders. We further show that conformational restriction via halogen substitution (e.g., NGT-201-18) potentiates degradation, a principle rationalized by DFT calculations, while comprehensive SAR studies chart a roadmap for next-generation degraders. Dose-response proteomics confirms VAV1 as the primary target and reveals LIMD1, bearing a canonical G-loop, as an off-target, showing that one glue can engage disparate degrons. These findings expand the landscape of CRBN neosubstrate recognition and offer a therapeutic strategy for targeting VAV1.
abstract_zh: 本研究报道了一系列CRBN分子胶，其能够选择性诱导VAV1的蛋白酶体降解，VAV1是一种造血特异性信号蛋白，也是血液系统恶性肿瘤和自身免疫性疾病中的关键靶点。通过无偏全局蛋白质组学，我们鉴定出苯基戊二酰亚胺衍生物（如NGT-201-12）为有效的VAV1降解剂，其与VAV1的C端SH3结构域（SH3-2）结合。我们阐明了SH3-2中一个非经典RT-loop降解决定子（RDxS基序，残基796-799），这与先前表征的G-loop降解决定子不同，并得到物理学和AI驱动的GluePlex工作流程及定点突变的支持。将自由能微扰（Free Energy Perturbation, FEP）应用于预测的三元结构，可得到与降解效力相关的协同性指标，从而克服了标准对接的局限性，并能够对类似物进行前瞻性排序——即使是从弱初始结合物开始。我们进一步表明，通过卤素取代（如NGT-201-18）实现的构象限制可增强降解作用，这一原理通过DFT计算得到合理化解释，而全面的SAR研究则为下一代降解剂绘制了路线图。剂量反应蛋白质组学确认VAV1为主要靶点，并揭示携带经典G-loop的LIMD1为脱靶蛋白，表明一种分子胶可作用于不同的降解决定子。这些发现扩展了CRBN新底物识别的范围，并为靶向VAV1提供了一种治疗策略。
